methodology.purpose: Supply only information published before the declared preseason cutoff for a time-correct 2025 caller-transition backtest.
methodology.source_scope: The article explicitly says it covers all 32 offensive play callers heading into the 2025 season. Its rankings and opinions are not model inputs; only the caller identities in its headings are transcribed.
methodology.ambiguity_rule: The Giants heading and text leave Brian Daboll versus Mike Kafka unresolved. Preserve both candidates and exclude the team from all scored windows instead of selecting the eventual caller with hindsight.
methodology.time_rule: Every source used for caller identity must be published on or before August 31, 2025.
